title: Enactment of the New York City Plumbing Code.
officialText:
The New York city plumbing code based on the 2003 edition of the International Plumbing Code published by the International Code Council, with changes that reflect the unique character of the city and amendments that bring it up to date with the 2015 edition of such International Plumbing Code, is hereby adopted to read as follows:

(Am. L.L. 2020/014, 1/10/2020, eff. 11/7/2022)
